in_arabic.name: سوخان
in_arabic.meaning: كلمة تعبر عن الحكمة و الفهم العميق للكلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سوخان مشتق من الجذر اللغوي س-خ-ن، ويعني الحكمة و الفهم العميق للكلام و التعبير عنه بطريقة سلسة و سهلة. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة في الشخصية الإسلامية، حيث يدل على الحكمة و الفطنة في التعامل مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: سوخان
in_urdu.meaning: حکمت اور گہری سمجھ کے ساتھ گفتگو کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: سوخان نام عربی زبان کی س-خ-ن جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حکمت اور گہری سمجھ کے ساتھ گفتگو کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں شخصیت کی خوبیاں ظاہر کرنے والا माना جاتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ حکمت اور معاملات میں گہری سمجھ کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सुखान
in_hindi.meaning: बुद्धिमत्ता और गहरी समझ के साथ बोलना
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुखान नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के स-ख-न मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता और गहरी समझ के साथ बोलना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं को प्रकट करने वाला माना जाता है, क्योंकि यह बुद्धिमत्ता और दूसरों के साथ व्यवहार में गहरी समझ को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: سوخان
in_pashto.meaning: په حکمت او پکې پوهې سره خبرې کول
in_pashto.long_meaning: سوخان نوم د عربي ژبې د س-خ-ن ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې په حکمت او پکې پوهې سره خبرې کول دي. دا نوم د اسلامي دوديزې په چوکاټ کې د شخصيت ځانګړتياوو ښودلو لپاره کارول کېږي، ځکه چې حکمت او په چارو کې ژوره پوهه څرګندوي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sukhan carries a deep sense of gift or blessing in Islamic culture. It is a reminder that all blessings come from Allah, and the name serves as a constant reminder to be grateful for the blessings we receive in life. This can manifest in various ways, such as expressing gratitude for physical possessions, good health, or relationships. Sukhan is a beautiful and meaningful name that can evoke feelings of happiness, contentment, and abundance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sukhan holds significant spiritual meaning in Islam. It is a reminder that all good things come from Allah, and that we are His blessed creations. The name encourages us to focus on the divine source of our blessings and to remain humble and grateful. It also serves as a reminder of the wisdom and blessing that can come from challenges and hardships in life. Overall, the name Sukhan is a powerful symbol of the abundant blessings and mercy of Allah.

historical_references.reference: The name Sukhan is derived from the Arabic word 'sukhan' meaning 'lucky' or 'auspicious'. It is believed that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) passed through a place named Sukhan during his migration from Mecca to Medina in 622 AD. The people of Sukhan welcomed him and his companions warmly, providing them with shelter and supplies. This act of kindness and hospitality earned the name 'Sukhan' a significant place in Islamic history.
historical_references.context: Migration of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) from Mecca to Medina

historical_references.reference: Another historical reference related to the name Sukhan comes from the Islamic tradition of 'As-Sahabah' (The Companions of the Prophet). It is said that during the Battle of Hunayn (630 AD), the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) passed through a place named Sukhan. The people of Sukhan, who were mainly Christians, were initially reluctant to accept Islam. However, they were later won over by the Prophet's peaceful approach and his promise of peace and prosperity. This led to the spread of Islam in the region, and Sukhan became an important center of Islamic culture and learning.
historical_references.context: Spread of Islam in the region of Sukhan
